title: Palace sign Chilwell and Timber after deadline
summary: Crystal Palace have signed defenders Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber on permanent deals, adding international experience to their squad. The signings strengthen Palace's defensive options following the transfer deadline.
content: Crystal Palace have signed internationals Ben Chilwell and Quinten Timber on permanent deals

zh.title: 水晶宫签下奇尔韦尔和蒂姆伯
zh.summary: 水晶宫已与本·奇尔韦尔和昆滕·蒂姆伯签署永久合约，为球队增加国际水平的后卫。这两项签约加强了水晶宫在转会截止期后的防线实力。

title: Everton sell Scotland's Patterson to Torino
summary: Everton have sold Scotland international right-back Nathan Patterson to Italian club Torino. The transfer fee remains undisclosed.
content: Everton sell Scotland right-back Nathan Patterson to Torino for an undisclosed fee.

zh.title: 埃弗顿将苏格兰球员帕特森出售给都灵
zh.summary: 埃弗顿已将苏格兰国脚右后卫内森·帕特森出售给意大利俱乐部都灵。转会费用未公开。
